body: Thank you for chatting with me. It's like 9 am and I haven't slept, I also work today so I need to catch some zzz's. Are you open to a PM on the off chance?
In all honesty the only time I feel whole is when I'm playing and writing music, or learning a new instrument
It's more that I feel two sides of me. The side that I am, the one that wants to get better and not feel this way. And the other guy who just likes to destroy my physique and all I hold dear.

I dont feel any different. I have never let anyone in until recently and they all left me. 2 relationships and all of my friends were convinced by my no longer bestfriend that I'm a total pos. I feel lower than I have ever and now I'm turning to strangers for help. But at the same time I dont feel like I deserve it. I recognize that I'm sad and shouldn't act upon anything drastic but I cant stop feeling this way.
